A human '''singer''' performed a series of concerts on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. In order to promote their concerts, a [[Concert Every Night|series of posters]] were put up around [[Imperial City|Galactic City]], containing the [[Musician|singer]] holding a microphone. The caption, which was written in [[Aurebesh]], read "concert every night"<ref name="LT" /> – "call 050506."<ref name="SW-Lethal Trackdown Concept Art Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/lethal-trackdown-concept-art-gallery|text="Lethal Trackdown" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 7}}</ref>
